name: checkpoint
description: Context checkpoints for Even Keel chain sessions of Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode: once the context passes 200k tokens (and every 50k after, every 25k past 250k), the session is asked to write a handoff note and end its turn with `CHECKPOINT: <path>`, so that Even Keel continues the task in a fresh session instead of re-reading the whole context on every turn. A session that writes the note but forgets the line is sent back to add it. The context and the note come from Even Keel, which reads the transcripts of both agents, so a session it did not start is left alone. The first threshold is the project's calibrated one, and a task that has had three handoffs is asked only from 300k; on a small context window the late and hard thresholds come down to 85 % and 95 % of it. A project that turns handoffs by context off in Even Keel gets no nudge at all and is left to the agent's own compaction. Thresholds: CHECKPOINT_FIRST_TOKENS, CHECKPOINT_STEP_TOKENS, CHECKPOINT_LATE_TOKENS, CHECKPOINT_LATE_STEP_TOKENS, CHECKPOINT_HARD_TOKENS and CHECKPOINT_MAX_HANDOFFS. In a chain session of a project without a CI to judge its main branch, the merge of the task branch waits for the project's check commands from Even Keel and is blocked while they fail. A message the user writes from Even Keel's chat to a working session reaches it mid-turn: before or after its next tool call, at its stop (the turn goes on), or in place of a question it was about to ask. A tool call Claude Code stops on a permission dialog for is asked on Even Keel's page too, and the user's "Allow" or "Deny" there answers the dialog without stopping the session. An MCP call Claude Code made before loading the tool's schema, whose numbers or lists went as strings and failed the server's validation, gets a hint in the context: load the schema with ToolSearch and repeat the call. A project's standards, set on Even Keel's page (a document of the repository and the files it guards): the first read of a guarded file brings the document into the context, the first edit of one before that is refused with the document, a compaction brings it again, and a standard that asks for it holds the merge (in PR mode, the PULL REQUEST mark) of a branch that changed its files until `.temp/shot/` has shots newer than the change and `.temp/<document>-check.md` answers each question of the document's section "The check". OpenCode sessions get the nudges and the chat's messages after each tool call, the standards, the merge check and the CHECKPOINT line from the plugin's OpenCode plugin (opencode/checkpoint.mjs): a turn that wrote the note gets the line added to its last text instead of being sent back.
